```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame with string user_id and float64 score
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [1.5, 2.7, 3.9]
}))

# Convert user_id to Int32 and score to Float32
df = df.with_columns(
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32),
)

print(df)
print(df.schema)
```
